title: Burning the figures in the crucible

dating.label: Neo-Assyrian · Neo/Late Babylonian witnesses
dating.note: The linked source witnesses carry Neo-Assyrian, Neo/Late Babylonian period labels. These date surviving manuscripts, not the composition.

purpose: Inside a drawn circle, arrange figures of nine materials in a crucible, identify them as the witchcraft's doer, kindle a torch, and throw fire into the crucible to burn them.
attribution: Ritual tablet (Tablet IX) of the Maqlû ceremony; the practitioner acts

phases.name: Circle and figures
phases.idea: A circle is drawn round the crucible, the figures are set in it and identified as the doer.

phases.name: Kindle the torch
phases.idea: A torch is set on the fat figures, dressed with woods and lit from sulphur fire.

phases.name: Burn
phases.idea: Fire is thrown into the crucible.

steps.title: Draw a magic circle round the crucible
steps.shortTitle: Draw a magic circle round the crucible
steps.shortDescription: A magic circle is drawn around the crucible.
steps.summary: A magic circle is drawn around the crucible.
steps.evidence: Line 22′ glosses "magic circle, crucible, draw"; the materials gypsum and a kind of flour are named in the incantation line 21′ just before and are only probably the drawing medium.

steps.title: Arrange figures of nine materials in the crucible
steps.shortTitle: Arrange figures of nine materials in the crucible
steps.shortDescription: Figures of tamarisk, cedar, tallow, wax, husks, bitumen, gypsum, clay and dough are placed in order in the crucible.
steps.summary: Figures of tamarisk, cedar, tallow, wax, husks, bitumen, gypsum, clay and dough are placed in order in the crucible.
steps.patient: Figures of tamarisk, cedar, tallow, wax, husks, bitumen, gypsum, clay and dough
steps.evidence: Lines 23′–25′ list the nine figures; line 25′ glosses "in the crucible place in order, put". The figures are not said here to be made, only set out, so no fashioning step is mapped.

steps.title: Point at the figures and name them as the doer
steps.shortTitle: Point at the figures and name them as the doer
steps.shortDescription: Reciting the incantation "this effigy of the doer", the practitioner stretches a finger toward the figures.
steps.summary: Reciting the incantation "this effigy of the doer", the practitioner stretches a finger toward the figures.
steps.evidence: Line 26′ glosses "incantation: this effigy (of the) doer; finger to skull (= over them) stretch out; count". The utterance is classed as a declaration identifying the figures with the witch.

steps.shortTitle: Put a torch on the tallow and wax figures

steps.summary: With a further incantation, a torch is put on the tallow and wax figures.
steps.evidence: Lines 27′–28′: incantation, "effigy tallow, effigy wax, on them torch put". That the torch is already lit is not stated.

steps.title: Stick cedar, cypress, myrtle and reed into it
steps.shortTitle: Stick cedar, cypress, myrtle and reed into it
steps.shortDescription: Cedar, cypress, myrtle(?) and good reed are stuck into its interior and something is sprinkled.
steps.summary: Cedar, cypress, myrtle(?) and good reed are stuck into its interior and something is sprinkled.
steps.patient: Cedar, cypress, myrtle and good reed
steps.evidence: Lines 28′–29′ gloss "cedar, cypress, myrtle, (a tree), good reed, in interior stick in … sprinkle". What they are stuck into (the torch or the crucible) and what is sprinkled are not clear from the glosses; one sign group is broken.

steps.shortTitle: Light the torch from sulphur fire and recite

steps.title: Throw fire into the crucible
steps.shortDescription: Fire is thrown into the crucible, burning the figures set in it.
steps.summary: Fire is thrown into the crucible, burning the figures set in it.
steps.evidence: Line 31′ glosses "fire to interior crucible throw". The burning of the figures is inferred from the context (lines 23′–28′); the following incantations (32′ff.) are each assigned to single figures.
